proof:
letI : IsScalarTower (R p) ℚ ℂ :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r => rfl)
  let μ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ :=
    (J p M (ev y v 0)).subtype.liftBaseChange ℚ
  have hden : ∀ t : ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0),
      ∃ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c : J p M (ev y v 0),
        (n : ℚ) • t = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c := by
    
    intro t
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
    | tmul q c =>
      refine ⟨q.den, q.den_ne_zero, (q.num : R p) • c, ?_⟩
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, Rat.den_mul_eq_num]
      rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
    | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨n, hn, c, hc⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨m, hm, d, hd⟩ := hb
      refine ⟨n * m, Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hm, m • c + n • d, ?_⟩
      rw [smul_add, Nat.cast_mul]
      calc
        ((n : ℚ) * m) • a + ((n : ℚ) * m) • b =
            (m : ℚ) • ((n : ℚ) • a) + (n : ℚ) • ((m : ℚ) • b) := by
              simp only [smul_smul]; rw [mul_comm (m : ℚ) n]
        _ = (m : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] c) +
            (n : ℚ) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] d) := by rw [hc, hd]
        _ = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[R p] (m • c + n • d) := by
          simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    
  constructor
  · refine ⟨μ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q c
      change q • (c : ℂ) = _
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
    · apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero μ).2
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨n, hn, c, hc⟩ := hden t
      have hc0 : c = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hh := congrArg μ hc
        simpa only [map_smul, ht, smul_zero, μ,
          LinearMap.liftBaseChange_one_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
          Submodule.coe_zero] using hh.symm
      have hnt : (n : ℚ) • t = 0 := by
        rw [hc, hc0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hnt).resolve_left (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn)
    · simp [μ, LinearMap.range_liftBaseChange]
  · letI : Module.Finite (R p) (J p M (ev y v 0)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_fg h_T011.2.2.1
    infer_instance
